title: InstanceCode
description: This schema defines the InstanceCode entity. An InstanceCode is a common/reference code entry, identified by a code group and code value, used as shared master data across the platform.

id.description: Unique identifier that identifies this InstanceCode instance.

name.description: Name that identifies this InstanceCode instance uniquely.

fullyQualifiedName.description: A unique name that identifies an InstanceCode.

displayName.description: Display Name that identifies this InstanceCode.

codeGroupName.description: Human readable label for the code group (e.g. '가감구분코드').

codeValue.description: The code value within the code group (e.g. 'KR', 'ACTIVE').

codeName.description: Human readable label for this code value.

sortOrder.description: Display sort order of this code within its code group.

active.description: Whether this code is currently active/usable.

updatedAt.description: Last update time corresponding to the new version of the entity in Unix epoch time milliseconds.

impersonatedBy.description: Bot user that performed the action on behalf of the actual user.

href.description: Link to the resource corresponding to this InstanceCode.

changeDescription.description: Change that lead to this version of the entity.

incrementalChangeDescription.description: Change that lead to this version of the entity.

deleted.description: When `true` indicates the entity has been soft deleted.

dataProducts.description: List of data products this entity is part of.

extension.description: Entity extension data with custom attributes added to the entity.
